race.comment: ZAVEGA (6) made it three wins from her last four starts, all at 1000m, when she got home by the skin of her teeth in a BM58 at the Gold Coast five weeks ago. Very good fresh performer and has to date been unbeatable in these sharp sprints. Yet to win on a wet track which is the only reservation. PEREGRINA PEARL (11) has returned this prep under new trainer Melissa Dennett in outstanding form, leading all the way to win both races. Had to pull out all the stops to get the prize over 900m at Scone last time. Untried on a wet track but deserves the benefit of the doubt. Lightly raced four-year-old DENMAN BANDIT (5) returns from a 20-week spell. Has won in the wet and when first-up so he has the right credentials. KATE'S TIARA (8) has been about the money of late in longer races. Boasts a fine record over this sort of trip and the wetter the better for her. SOOBOOCO (1) mixes his form but at his best is capable of fully testing this field.
